description: Check, without changing anything, that a host is ready for the bootstrap plans: root access, a fully qualified hostname, name resolution, package availability, and reachable URLs. Reports problems in its result instead of failing.

require_fqdn.description: Report an error if `hostname -f` isn't fully qualified.

resolve.description: Space-separated host names that must resolve on this host.

packages.description: Space-separated packages that must be available from this host's configured repositories (dnf only).

postgres_source.description: Check that the PostgreSQL server packages for this source (`pgdg` or `os`) are available.

postgres_version.description: The PostgreSQL major version to check for.

urls.description: Space-separated URLs that must be reachable from this host.
